bubble.note: Per-app Data API; swagger only per app when enabled

cal.note: Self-hosted instances use their own host

clearbit.note: No published spec; API sunset under HubSpot

copper.note: Only an official Postman collection; no OpenAPI.

cortex.note: TheHive Cortex publishes no machine-readable spec.

exclusions.refresh-tokens: OAuth token refresh on oauth.pipedrive.com, authenticated with the app's client secret

plivo.note: no public spec found; Auth ID/Auth Token as basic auth

post_hog.note: ~9 MB spec of the private /api/ endpoints; public capture endpoints used by n8n (/capture, /batch) are not in it; US/EU cloud or self-hosted

postmark.note: account API uses X-Postmark-Account-Token instead of the server token

profit_well.note: no public spec; ProfitWell is now part of Paddle

pushbullet.note: no public spec; Access-Token header also accepted

pushcut.note: Vendor-certified Power Platform connector spec. The official https://api.pushcut.io/openapi.yaml splits paths and schemas into relative files (paths/*.yaml), which the generator cannot bundle; its other operations are hand-written in the preset.

pushover.note: No vendor spec; only a third-party Power Platform connector exists. Token also accepted as a form body field

qdrant.note: Self-hosted or Qdrant Cloud cluster URL

quickbase.note: Vendor spec from developer.quickbase.com, mirrored in a third-party repo; also needs QB-Realm-Hostname header

quickbooks.note: Intuit states it has no OpenAPI file; Postman collections are only in the Postman workspace, with no public raw JSON

rabbitmq.note: n8n uses AMQP; management HTTP API has only a third-party OpenAPI spec

raindrop.note: No vendor spec; unofficial spec at lasuillard/raindrop-client openapi.yaml

reddit.note: No official machine-readable spec; OAuth calls go to oauth.reddit.com

rocketchat.note: Spec is split by area; marketplace-apps.yaml is not included (its /api/apps routes are outside the /api/v1 credential path and duplicate miscellaneous.yaml).

rundeck.note: Vendor spec lives in the rundeck/go-rundeck SDK repo; paths are versioned (/api/{v}/...)

s3.note: AWS SigV4 signing, which cannot be expressed as a header/query/basic rule; the n8n node targets any S3-compatible endpoint

exclusions.PutBucketLifecycle: Deprecated by AWS; the current configuration operation serves the same route
exclusions.PutBucketNotification: Deprecated by AWS; the current configuration operation serves the same route

salesforce.note: No machine-readable spec the generator can use: the OpenAPI file is generated per org (beta), and Salesforce's Postman collection (documenter 12721794/TVmFjfuh) has no request schemas, so every body would be unchecked. The preset is hand-written with a captured API version.

salesmate.note: Maintained by hand from Salesmate's API documentation. Documented hosts are the per-account link https://<link>.salesmate.io/apis/... and https://apis.salesmate.io (v3 sequence enrollment). The session token goes in accessToken for v4 and sessionToken for v1/v3; x-linkname names the account. Salesmate's published Postman collection (documenter collection 7811505/S1ZucWTA) is not used: its collection-level scripts send every request's headers, body and response to http://191.96.225.224:3007/webhook, a host Salesmate does not operate.

sea_table.note: Default branch is versioned (v7.0) and changes with releases; API tokens are exchanged for base tokens sent as Bearer; account, team admin, system admin and Python scheduler specs need other credentials; self-hosted servers use the origin field

sear_xng.note: Self-hosted; no published spec and no auth by default

segment.note: No machine-readable spec for the tracking API (api.segment.io/v1); the write key is the basic-auth username

send_grid.note: OpenAPI 3.1, split per product. EU data-residency accounts use api.eu.sendgrid.com.

send_in_blue.note: Brevo also serves the API on its former host api.sendinblue.com.

sendy.note: Self-hosted with no spec; api_key goes in the POST form body

sentry_io.note: Self-hosted Sentry and regional hosts (us.sentry.io, de.sentry.io) also possible

send,write: Create an External Issue and Link It to an Issue
write: Link an Existing External Issue to an Issue

exclusions.retrieveApiIndex: The spec's index route joins its /api/0 base path without the trailing slash Sentry serves; the shipped descriptor matches /api/0/

service_now.note: Specs are exported per instance from the REST API Explorer; no public file, only community specs

shopify.note: The Admin GraphQL introspection JSON (@shopify/dev-mcp dist/data/admin_{version}.json.gz) parses and covers every shipped mutation, but generation groups mutations by payload type, which would split about 400 of them into one-mutation resources, so the preset stays hand-written: mutations are hand-classified from the 2026-10 schema. REST Admin is legacy with no spec.

signl4.note: n8n uses the webhook /webhook/{teamSecret} (secret in path), which is not in the REST spec; the REST API uses the X-S4-Api-Key header

slack.note: Official current Web API method documentation, indexed by the vendor sitemap; each page has a content hash. The Events API is not covered: its inbound event payloads are outside outgoing request recognition. SCIM, Audit Logs, and Legal Holds are separate HTTP API families without a machine-readable source; their descriptors are hand-written in the preset.

snowflake.note: Every specification in snowflakedb/snowflake-rest-api-specs except the shared common*.yaml files, which generation bundles. Cortex Agents run and result fetch are hand-written in the preset; Spark Connect's binary gRPC-over-HTTP operations are unsupported. Create operations with createMode=orReplace replace an existing object but are classified like other creates. The X-Snowflake-Authorization-Token-Type header is optional.

exclusions.getScopedToken: Internal Cortex Analyst OAuth token exchange, not a public API
exclusions.pullRequest: Internal endpoint for the stored-procedure Spark dataframe processor
exclusions.pushResponse: Internal endpoint for the stored-procedure Spark dataframe processor

splunk.note: Splunk confirms there is no OpenAPI spec for the Enterprise REST API

stackby.note: Postman documenter collection; its {{base_url}} is https://stackby.com/api.

storyblok.note: No official spec (vendor issue open). Auth shown is for the Management API; the Content API uses the ?token= query

strapi.note: Self-hosted; the OpenAPI file is generated per project by the documentation plugin

stripe.note: v1 from the full spec and v2 from the latest SDK spec. Operation servers place file uploads and quote PDFs on files.stripe.com and the meter event stream on meter-events.stripe.com.

supabase.note: Auth comes from supabase/auth's openapi.yaml. PostgREST, Storage, Edge Functions and GraphQL are hand-written: the PostgREST spec is generated per project, and Storage's api.json (supabase.github.io/storage) has no /storage/v1 server path.

superlinked.note: GET /v1/configs/models/{*id} is one catch-all route that also serves the /status form, so the separate status path is filtered and the catch-all descriptor takes model IDs with slashes. The SDK sends msgpack to encode, score and extract; those variants are maintained as descriptors keyed on the msgpack content type.

survey_monkey.note: No machine-readable official spec: the Postman collection linked from api.surveymonkey.com/v3/docs has expired. The certified Power Platform connector covers 8 real routes (its host is api.surveymonkey.net and its trigger/action routes use fake /v3/triggerN and /v3/actionsN prefixes, dropped by the include filter); the rest of the v3 API is hand-written in the preset from api.surveymonkey.com/v3/docs. Hosts: api.surveymonkey.com, api.eu.surveymonkey.com, api.surveymonkey.ca. The SCIM API at api.surveymonkey.com/scim/v2 is a separate family that uses a SCIM provisioning token, not the app access token.

exclusions.OnSurveyCreated: Power Platform trigger on the non-existent /v3/trigger1 route; the real GET /v3/surveys is GetSurveys
exclusions.OnSurveyCollectorCreated: Power Platform trigger on the non-existent /v3/trigger2 route; the real route is GetSurveyCollectors
exclusions.OnNewResponseAddedCollector: Power Platform trigger on the non-existent /v3/trigger3 route; GET /v3/collectors/{collector_id}/responses/bulk is hand-written
exclusions.OnNewResponseAddedSurvey: Power Platform trigger on the non-existent /v3/trigger4 route; GET /v3/surveys/{survey_id}/responses/bulk is hand-written
exclusions.OnNewResponseToQuestionAdded: Power Platform trigger on the non-existent /v3/trigger5 route; GET /v3/surveys/{survey_id}/responses/bulk is hand-written
exclusions.GetResponseDetails: Power Platform action on the non-existent /v3/actions1 route; GET /v3/surveys/{survey_id}/responses/{response_id}/details is hand-written
exclusions.GetResponseDetailsNoPages: Power Platform action on the non-existent /v3/actions2 route; GET /v3/surveys/{survey_id}/responses/{response_id}/details is hand-written

syncro_msp.note: Per-tenant X.syncromsp.com; spec also allows the api_key query

taiga.note: No published spec; the token comes from POST /api/v1/auth

telegram.note: Bot token goes in the path (/bot{token}/method). tgbotspec generates this OpenAPI description from the official Bot API reference (Bot API 10.3); it documents JSON and multipart bodies only.

the_hive.note: TheHive 5 spec (StrangeBee); the n8n node targets older /api/case endpoints that may be missing from it

the_hive_project.note: Spec is TheHive 5.8 (API v1); n8n node also uses deprecated v0 endpoints.
opaque: Import Case Report Template from file

todoist.note: Official unified API v1 spec; paths carry /api/v1 prefix.

toggl.note: URLs are content-hashed Docusaurus assets linked from engineering.toggl.com/docs/track/openapi/ and change on updates; the specs' host says localhost and the Webhooks spec has no base path. Shared saved reports (/reports/api/v3/shared) declare several body parameters, so that route is maintained in the preset.

travis_ci.note: No published OpenAPI for API v3; also requires Travis-API-Version: 3 header.

trello.note: Auth needs both key and token query params; OAuth1 alternative.

exclusions.put-enterprises-id-enterpriseJoinRequest: The spec writes this path parameter as ${id}; the preset keeps the documented /1/enterprises/{id}/enterpriseJoinRequest/bulk

twake.note: n8n uses a bespoke plugins.twake.app/plugins/n8n endpoint; no public spec.

twilio.note: Split per product; kept Core 2010 API (SMS/calls) and Events (trigger).

twist.note: Only HTML docs at developer.twist.com/v3; no machine-readable spec found.

twitter.note: api.x.com and the legacy api.twitter.com host share one origin set. The retired v1.1 media upload host (upload.twitter.com) is not covered; v2 media upload is.

typeform.note: Official Typeform Postman collection linked from their developer docs; no public OpenAPI. The collection declares no request bodies and predates the Translations, Media and response search APIs, which are hand-written in the preset from the reference at typeform.com/developers. Hosts: api.typeform.com, api.eu.typeform.com and api.typeform.eu.

exclusions.Create image: the collection gives this request a raw-string URL, which the Postman importer reads as path /; the include filter drops it and the documented route is hand-written in the preset

exclusions.Create workspace: the collection gives this request a raw-string URL, which the Postman importer reads as path /; the include filter drops it and the documented route is hand-written in the preset

unleashed_software.note: No public spec; requests also need HMAC api-auth-signature header.

uplead.note: No public spec found; raw API key in Authorization header.

uproc.note: No public spec found; basic auth with email:apiKey.

uptime_robot.note: Spec is API v3 (Bearer); n8n uses legacy v2 POST endpoints with api_key in body.

url_scan_io.note: Redocly bundle download URL from docs.urlscan.io; includes Pro endpoints.

venafi_tls_protect_cloud.note: ReadMe-hosted docs expose no downloadable spec without login; regional hosts api.venafi.cloud/.eu etc.

venafi_tls_protect_datacenter.note: WebSDK OpenAPI is served only by each customer's TPP instance; no public copy.

vercel_ai_gateway.note: No Vercel gateway spec; gateway is OpenAI-compatible under /v1, so OpenAI's spec filtered to those paths.

exclusions.listChatCompletions: AI Gateway does not store chat completions and documents no list endpoint

vero.note: No public spec; auth_token sent in JSON body or query.

vonage.note: Vonage APIs that accept an API key and secret (Basic auth): SMS, Messages (regional hosts), Account, Numbers, Pricing, Verify v2 and Number Insight. Voice and Video require application JWTs.

weaviate.note: REST only; clients also use gRPC. The server answers every route with or without a trailing slash.

webflow.note: Data API v2; n8n legacy mode uses v1 which is not covered.

whats_app.note: Meta business messaging spec covers WhatsApp messages/media; filename is version-pinned and may be replaced.

wise.note: Latest CalVer spec (paths under /2026Q4) plus the Legacy endpoint-versioned spec (/v1 to /v5). Production, sandbox and the transferwise.com hosts share one origin set.

wolfram_alpha.note: The APIs.guru copy of the retired ChatGPT plugin spec covers only llm-api and cloud-plugin; the Full Results, Simple, Short Answers, Spoken Results, Fast Query Recognizer and Summary Box APIs are hand-written from products.wolframalpha.com documentation.

woo_commerce.note: No official spec; only community OpenAPI ports of wc/v3.

wordpress.note: No official OpenAPI; WP REST API self-describes via /wp-json discovery index only.

workable.note: No public spec found for spi/v3.

xai_grok.note: Official spec served by xAI; OpenAI-compatible plus native endpoints. The US regional endpoint (us.api.x.ai) serves the same API with the same keys. The management API (management-api.x.ai) needs a separate management key and has no published spec.

xata.note: n8n uses legacy Xata serverless DB API (xata.sh); current xataio/xata specs are for the new Postgres platform.

xero.note: Accounting, Identity (connections), Assets, Projects and Files APIs; requests also need the xero-tenant-id header. Payroll and partner-only APIs (bank feeds, finance, app store) are not included.

exclusions.captions.insert.upload.session: its resumable continuation shares the PUT route of the update upload, which serves it with the same effects
exclusions.playlistImages.insert.upload.session: its resumable continuation shares the PUT route of the update upload, which serves it with the same effects

zammad.note: Zammad publishes no OpenAPI (open feature request); basic auth also supported.

zendesk.note: Support, Help Center and Talk API specs; per-tenant X.zendesk.com; basic is email/token:apiToken, OAuth uses Bearer.

zep.note: First spec is the deprecated v3 API (served under /api/v2 until April 13, 2027); second is the current v4 API. Legacy v2 SDK sessions, groups and collections descriptors are kept in the preset; self-hosted Zep differs.

zoho_crm.note: Specs are v8; the {version} path segment also matches older versions. Hosts vary by data center (www.zohoapis.com, .eu, .in, .com.au, .jp, .ca, .com.cn, .sa).

zoom.note: Meetings API spec (covers meetings and webinars); other products are separate api-hub specs. Operations use the global, regional (api-xx.zoom.us), vanity and Zoom for Government (api.zoomgov.com) hosts.

zulip.note: Basic auth with email:apiKey; per-org or self-hosted host.

exclusions.POST /real-time: Documentation page for the real-time events API, not an endpoint; clients use register and events
exclusions.rest-error-handling: Documentation page for error responses, not an endpoint
exclusions.zulip-outgoing-webhooks: Payload a Zulip server sends to an outgoing webhook bot, not a request to the Zulip API
